summary:
EarthSignal: Be an Earth System Trend Detective

EarthSignal is an interactive web-based platform designed to help users investigate long-term changes in Earth's systems using environmental data. It analyses global surface temperature anomalies and demonstrates how environmental indicators can reveal important trends over time. Users can explore graphs, select different time periods, calculate trend directions and understand the relationship between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere and biosphere. The platform supports importing NASA GISTEMP datasets to investigate real-world temperature observations. By transforming scientific data into accessible visual insights, EarthSignal encourages environmental awareness, critical thinking and evidence-based understanding of Earth's changing climate. Its main objective is to make Earth observation data easier to explore and understand, helping users become Earth System Trend Detectives.
details: EarthSignal is an interactive, web-based platform designed to help users explore environmental changes and understand long-term trends. It allows users to select environmental indicators, choose time periods, visualize data through graphs and trend lines, and compare changes using NASA GISTEMP datasets. The project aims to make complex scientific information easier to understand, improve environmental awareness, and encourage evidence-based discussions about climate change. Its innovative approach is to transform environmental data into an interactive investigation, helping students understand how the atmosphere, oceans, ice, land and living organisms are interconnected.
